title: Observability and error handling
problem: Silent errors and missing signals hide operational failures.
rationale: Product service changes require applicable checks/review; a logging import or number of log statements is not observability proof.
applicability: Changed service behavior, failure paths and health/readiness interfaces.
baseline_policy: No legacy waiver for required verification or release prerequisites.

target_check.deterministic: health/readiness and induced-error smoke tests, expected structured fields/correlation IDs, no secrets/PII in fixtures, mapped exception-policy checks.
target_check.reviewer: signals, bounded labels, useful alerts/runbook and failure propagation.
target_check.limits: **D:** health/readiness and induced-error smoke tests, expected structured fields/correlation IDs, no secrets/PII in fixtures, mapped exception-policy checks. **R:** signals, bounded labels, useful alerts/runbook and failure propagation.
target_check.configuration: Project-approved native configuration, immutable source/tool/config pins and applicable evidence mappings; Product service changes require applicable checks/review; a logging import or number of log statements is not observability proof.

expected_evidence: **D:** health/readiness and induced-error smoke tests, expected structured fields/correlation IDs, no secrets/PII in fixtures, mapped exception-policy checks. **R:** signals, bounded labels, useful alerts/runbook and failure propagation.
repair: Exercise the failure path, propagate/report the error with useful bounded signals, and rerun health/error and redaction fixtures. Missing prerequisites remain Unsupported/Error.
